拖动补卡：设置今日已上班时长，收入同步重算；满每日时长按全天工资结算。: Drag to adjust today's hours. Earnings update immediately. A full shift settles one day's pay.

随时修改薪资制度和参数，当前记录按新设置重新估算: Change pay settings any time; recalculate only the current record
本次记录会保存在日历中，主面板重新计时。月薪和设置保留。: Save this session to the calendar and reset the timer. Pay settings are kept.
可随时修改，当前面板对应记录按新参数重新估算；其他历史记录保留。: Changes recalculate the current session only. Other history stays unchanged.
薪资须大于 0 且不超过 10 亿；每日时长须大于 0 且不超过 24 小时；月: Pay must be greater than 0 and at most 1 billion. Daily hours: greater than 0 to 24. Monthly workdays: 1–31.
含全天工资结算；计时时长保留实际记录。: Includes full-day settlement; actual hours are preserved.
按实际计时时长估算，暂停期间不计费。: Estimated from tracked hours. Pauses are excluded.
记录保存在本机；跨午夜的打卡归入开始日期。: Saved locally. Overnight sessions belong to their start date.

月薪 ÷ 每月工作日 = 日薪；日薪 ÷ 每日小时数 = 时薪。: Daily pay = monthly salary ÷ workdays. Hourly rate = daily pay ÷ daily hours.
忍忍，别和钱过不去。: Hang in there. Don't argue with payday.
来都来了，赚点再走。: You're already here. Earn a little first.
工作可以没头绪，工资不能没着落。: Work can be confusing. Payday should be clear.
今天的忍耐，明天的外卖。: Today's patience pays for tomorrow's takeout.
先别掀桌，桌上还有工资。: Don't flip the desk. Your paycheck is on it.
人可以放空，工资照常到账。: Mind on airplane mode. Pay still coming in.
上班图什么？图银行卡多个零。: Why work? The bank balance has its reasons.
先把钱挣了，其他的下班再说。: Earn first. Everything else can wait till after work.
你以为我在上班？我在攒不上班的钱。: Working? I'm saving up to stop working.
离财务自由还远，离下班已经近了。: Freedom is far away. Clocking out is closer.
情绪先放一放，钱要一分分赚。: Take a breath. The pennies are adding up.
这一秒的班，是下一口饭的底气。: This moment at work pays for the next bite.
今天也在为想买就买添砖加瓦。: Building the 'buy it if I want it' fund.
不想上班是真的，想要工资也是真的。: Don't want to work. Do want the paycheck.
给生活低个头，给余额抬个头。: Keep your head down. Let your balance rise.
今天多坐一会儿，周末多点一道菜。: A little more work. One more dish this weekend.
上班时想开点，发薪时想买点。: Take work lightly. Take payday shopping.
先赚今天的钱，再做明天的梦。: Earn today's pay. Dream tomorrow's dreams.
班可以上得勉强，工资必须领得坦荡。: Reluctant at work. Proud at payday.
